label: MongoDB

scripts.name: MONGODB_SCAN
scripts.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE RUST SCALAR SCRIPT {schema}.MONGODB_SCAN(spec VARCHAR(2000000))
EMITS (...) AS
%udf_object {udf_object}
/

failures.pattern: MongoDB error while reading collection metadata

login_or_connection.message: MongoDB refused the connection or the login (the adapter does not say which).
login_or_connection.hint: Check, in this order: the user ({user}) and its password, and that it is defined in the authentication database ({auth_source}); TLS - a MongoDB on this machine or a private network without TLS needs --tls none, one with TLS needs a certificate from a public authority; and that {host}:{port} answers from inside the database container.

auth.message: MongoDB refused the user name or password.
auth.hint: Check the user ({user}), its password, and the authentication database ({auth_source}): the user must be defined there and be allowed to read {database}.

permission.hint: Grant the user the read role on {database}, then: exakit source check {name|lower}

notes: One collection is one virtual schema: the documents form a root table (the MongoDB _id is mongo_id), a nested object becomes a child table joined on root."<field>|object" = child."_id", and an array becomes <ROOT>_<field>_arr joined on "_parent" = root."_id" (position "_pos", value "_value").
Child tables and fields keep their MongoDB spelling: quote them, e.g. VS_X."PEOPLE_profile"."city".
Columns are inferred from a sample of up to 100 documents; after the collection's shape changes, run: exakit source refresh <name>.
Filters, projections, LIMIT and aggregates run in MongoDB; nothing is copied into Exasol.
